title: PAH-OMC-014 finite-block and two-tail errors compose into one full-Q Cauchy envelope
question: How do the R-503 finite-block mixture drift and the two R-506 weighted-tail bounds combine into the exact comparison error required by PAH-OMC-014?
finding: Lean R507 proves that if the finite block drift is at most card(I)*(C*e_w+e_a) and the two omitted tails satisfy |t_j|<=C*tau_j, then the full comparison obeys |(b1+t1)-(b2+t2)|<=card(I)*(C*e_w+e_a)+C*tau1+C*tau2. A zero-tail corollary is also proved. Integrated, independent and hostile verifiers pass on distinct exact rational fixtures.
decision_reason: R503 and R506 are separate conditional bridges. R507 composes them without choosing a sector law, fitting errors, changing PAH-001, or using C_sw=540 as a measure. The result identifies the exact source-owner deliverable needed for a future Cauchy proof: instantiate the block and tail quantities on every cylinder and prove the displayed envelope tends to zero in the fixed order.
boundary: Conditional finite error composition only. PAH-001 functional/rates, PAH-OMC-010 Gibbs weighting, PAH-OMC-012 graded domain/projection and PAH-OMC-014 limit order remain unchanged. R-484 hidden-diagonal defect 16/9 is retained; R-490 C_sw=540 remains domination-only. No source law, projective limit, Cauchy sequence, positivity/normalization, stationarity, semigroup, continuum or physical conclusion is claimed.
next_action: Obtain a source-owned normalized cross-Q law and instantiate b_j,t_j,e_w,e_a,C,tau_j for every finite-support cylinder, with the composed envelope tending to zero under the fixed PAH-001 order; then apply the existing R498/R496 convergence bridge.
method: Hash-pin PAH-001, PAH-OMC-014, the projective-kernel obligation and the R503, R504, R505 and R506 manifests.
Formalize the exact real triangle-inequality composition of one finite-block bound and two tail bounds in Lean 4.32.1, keeping the block and tail values abstract.
Register R507 with its exact source SHA-256 and verify the source policy and declaration markers.
Replay integrated, independent and hostile verifiers with distinct exact Fraction fixtures and in-memory mutation tests.
Retain HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE because no source-owned cross-Q law or ordered decay estimate is present.
assumptions: A finite common index type supplies the card(I) factor inherited from R503.
The finite block has the R503 bound card(I)*(C*e_w+e_a).
Each omitted full-Q tail has the R506 bound C*tau_j.
All quantities are supplied under unchanged PAH-001 conventions and are not fit to the target observable.
missing_assumptions: A source-authorized normalized cross-Q sector law or projective kernel.
Source-owned block/tail values, common envelope and e_w/e_a/tau decay for every finite-support cylinder.
A common cylinder topology and proof that the composed envelope tends to zero in the declared n/R_max order.
A domain and uniform-integrability argument for positivity, normalization and stationarity after convergence.
